source.title: What Do Learning Dynamics Reveal About Generalization in LLM Reasoning?
source.authors: Katie Kang; Amrith Rajagopal Setlur; Dibya Ghosh; Jacob Steinhardt; Claire J. Tomlin; Sergey Levine; Aviral Kumar

page_placements.theme: Training-derived predictors depend on their target and validation setting

record.file_problem: none; full paper text is present
record.tranche_reason: The study measures how a training-dynamics metric relates to held-out reasoning accuracy and prompt robustness, using different constructs from the listed claim versions.
record.gate_note: The study does not test random-label fitting, the listed architecture/optimizer/batch-size/regularization/width conditions, magnitude-aware sharpness, or removing memorized training examples. Its own pre-memorization accuracy, perturbation, and data-curation results bear on generalization but do not match a listed version. Prior-work results are not included as rows.
record.test_reason: The study reports its own results on LLM reasoning generalization, but none tests V1–V8. Exact solution-trace replication differs from random-label fitting in V1 and inclusion-based memorization in V8. Its prediction metric and comparator metrics do not measure magnitude-aware sharpness in V7.
record.authors_conclusion: The record's paraphrase is accurate: the authors conclude that pre-memorization train accuracy predicts aggregate test accuracy, indicates per-example prompt robustness, and guides more sample-efficient data collection. The prediction results use a task- and model-specific calibrated threshold; Appendix A.1 also reports calibration transfer to held-out runs and test examples.
record.recipe_differences: LLM reasoning finetuning and learning-dynamics measurements; it does not reproduce the listed claim versions' interventions or measurements.
record.method_sensitivity: The reported prediction relationship varies across model and task (R2 ranges from 0.88 to 0.97). The memorization threshold depends on task and pretrained model, though the authors say it does not depend on training parameters.

fits_no_version.finding: Pre-memorization train accuracy predicts test accuracy with R² values of 0.94, 0.95, 0.97, and 0.88 after task- and model-specific threshold calibration.
fits_no_version.proposed_claim: Calibrated pre-memorization train accuracy predicts held-out accuracy across the tested LLM reasoning finetuning runs and checkpoints.

fits_no_version.finding: Section 4.2 compares generalization predictors and reports four correlation coefficients, but the supplied text does not identify their individual plot mappings.
fits_no_version.proposed_claim: The proposed learning-dynamics predictor compares favorably with the tested alternative predictors in the GSM8k Llama3 8B experiments.

fits_no_version.finding: Training examples with lower pre-memorization accuracy show greater accuracy degradation under solution-preamble perturbations.
fits_no_version.proposed_claim: Per-example pre-memorization accuracy indicates robustness to the tested reasoning-preamble perturbations.

fits_no_version.finding: Collecting rephrased examples targeted at low pre-memorization accuracy yields reported sample-efficiency gains of 2× on GSM8k and 1.5× on MATH levels 1–3.
fits_no_version.proposed_claim: Pre-memorization-guided data collection improves sample efficiency relative to i.i.d. collection in the tested settings.

record.problems: No uncertainty estimates are stated for the reported coefficients or sample-efficiency comparisons. The text describes prompt-perturbation trends without numerical values. The coefficient list for prior metrics is not individually mapped to metric names in the supplied text.

untested.parts: No fixed random-label training, natural-versus-random-label comparison, or chance-level held-out control.
No width sweep beyond the width required for zero training error.
No convolutional-versus-fully-connected comparison or local-connectivity intervention.
No controlled adaptive-optimizer-versus-SGD comparison; different model recipes do not establish an optimizer effect.
No controlled batch-size comparison under fixed epoch budgets or adapted recipes.
No dropout or joint dropout-and-weight-decay ablation.
No magnitude-scaled weight-perturbation sharpness measurement or comparison of its gap ranking with norm and margin measures.
No inclusion-based memorization estimation or retraining after removing highly memorized versus equally many random examples.

record.verdict_notes: States are cannot_determine with respect to V1–V8, not denials of the study's reported findings. Near-perfect replication of natural training traces alongside generalization does not establish V1's random-label capacity comparison. No verdict-bearing results are missing for the listed versions.

versions.untested_parts: Does not compare natural labels with fixed random labels or test the listed architectures and recipes.
No width sweep or interpolation-threshold analysis.
No convolutional versus fully connected architecture comparison.
No adaptive optimizer versus SGD comparison.
Does not measure magnitude-aware sharpness or compare it with norm- or margin-based measures.
Does not remove memorized examples and retrain.

rows.subject: Llama3 8B
rows.operation_detail: Compared existing generalization metrics with the ground-truth generalization gap for models finetuned on GSM8k.

conditions.value: Gradient variance; distance from initialization; Average Thresholded Confidence (ATC)

rows.measure: Correlation coefficients for the compared metrics; the text does not map each coefficient to a metric by name
rows.note: The text gives coefficients in left-to-right order but does not identify the individual plotted metrics in that order.
rows.check: This bundles four metric comparisons without recoverable individual mappings. It is a comparison supporting the authors' prediction method, rather than evidence on V7: no magnitude-aware sharpness is measured. Split and identify the metrics before retaining as separate results.

rows.subject: Two models; names not stated
rows.operation_detail: Evaluated prediction accuracy on original training prompts and prompts with short preambles appended.

conditions.value: Original prompts versus prompts perturbed with short preambles

rows.measure: Accuracy of model samples on perturbed prompts, discussed in relation to per-example pre-memorization accuracy
rows.baseline: Accuracy on unaltered training prompts is described as near-perfect
rows.value: Accuracy significantly degrades on perturbed prompts; degradation tends to be greater for examples with low pre-memorization accuracy
rows.note: The paper describes the trend but gives no numerical values in the text.
rows.check: The qualitative robustness result is supported, but does not measure any listed version. The actual accuracy distributions appear in Figure 7; Figure 6 illustrates the perturbations. Model identities and separate task conditions are not recoverable from the supplied prose.

rows.subject: Llama3 8B
rows.operation_detail: Curated added training data by prioritizing examples with low pre-memorization accuracy, then compared sample efficiency with other data collection approaches.

conditions.value: AdamW; batch size 128; learning rate 2e-5; 3 epochs

rows.measure: Sample efficiency at the same target test accuracy
rows.note: The reported outcome is for the authors' data-curation method.
rows.check: The 2× comparison is correctly reported, but is performance of the authors' data-curation method and should be excluded from claim-evidence rows. It adds GPT-rephrased examples rather than removing inclusion-defined memorized examples as in V8.
